title: VisualWebInstruct: Scaling up Multimodal Instruction Data through Web Search
authors_zh: Yiming Jia, Jiachen Li, Xiang Yue, Bo Li, Ping Nie, Kai Zou, Wenhu Chen
paper_type_zh: 多模态推理指令数据集与构造流程
best_for_zh: 适合构建或审计网页来源多模态 SFT 语料的研究者。
one_line: VisualWebInstruct turns image-guided web search into 906,160 multimodal and text QA demonstrations through extraction, consistency filtering, and source-answer alignment.
VisualWebInstruct 通过图像引导的网页搜索、答案一致性筛选与网页答案对齐，构造了 906,160 条多模态和纯文本问答示范。
why: It provides a concrete large-scale recipe for obtaining visual reasoning supervision beyond narrow synthetic diagrams or small academic datasets.
inclusion_reason: Releases a large web-mined collection of multimodal questions and worked answers and exposes the extraction, synthesis, filtering, and SFT consumption path.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language models have abundant perception data but much less broad, worked supervision for multi-step visual reasoning. VisualWebInstruct asks whether image-guided web search can find naturally occurring educational problems at a scale and diversity that narrow synthetic-image or school-level datasets do not provide.

The paper builds training data rather than a new reward or interactive environment: one record is a complete question, optional relevant image references, and an extracted or synthesized worked answer for SFT. It belongs in instruction, demonstration, and rationale data because the serialized answer is the training target; benchmark scores are only the evaluation surface.

L4 facts: primary sources arXiv 2503.10582 and the official EMNLP 2025 Main record, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.72; open dataset TIGER-Lab/VisualWebInstruct with 906,160 QA pairs, including 347,313 image-associated records over 163,743 unique images; full PDF, official project, code, dataset, construction stages, SFT consumer, and audit gaps verified, while the dataset-specific license remains unconfirmed.

视觉语言模型拥有大量感知数据，却缺少覆盖广泛、带完整解答的多步视觉推理监督。VisualWebInstruct 要回答的是：图像引导的网页搜索能否找到自然存在的教育题目，并在规模和学科多样性上超过狭窄的合成图像数据或中小学数据集。

本文构造的是训练数据，而不是新的奖励或交互环境：一条记录包含完整问题、可选的相关图像引用，以及供 SFT 使用的抽取或合成式完整答案。它属于指令、示范与理由数据，因为序列化答案才是训练目标，benchmark 分数只是评测表面。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv 2503.10582，以及 DOI 为 10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.72 的 EMNLP 2025 Main 正式记录；开放数据集 TIGER-Lab/VisualWebInstruct 共 906,160 条问答，其中 347,313 条关联图像，涉及 163,743 张去重图像；全文、项目页、代码、数据、构造阶段、SFT 消费方式与审计缺口均已核对，但数据集专用许可证仍未确认。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
VisualWebInstruct turns image-guided educational web search into reusable multimodal question-and-worked-answer demonstrations, with answer consistency and source-solution alignment selecting the SFT targets. Its closest comparisons are LLaVA-CoT and MAmmoTH-VL data; verifier- or RL-centered work is adjacent because the released static demonstration, rather than a reward signal, is the central artifact.

Google Scholar citations: 34（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=VisualWebInstruct%3A+Scaling+up+Multimodal+Instruction+Data+through+Web+Search&author=Yiming+Jia&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: VisualWebInstruct. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/VisualWebInstruct. Scale: 906,160 QA pairs containing 257,201 unique questions, including 347,313 image-associated pairs and 163,743 unique images. Record form: complete question, optional question-relevant image references, and a worked answer that preserves notation and step-by-step explanation, with source and filtering lineage where exposed. File / storage format: one Hugging Face Parquet shard plus images.zip; the repository also exposes the mixed-conversation and QA records in both JSONL and Parquet. Domains / languages: primarily English educational QA: 62.5% mathematics, 14.5% physics, 7.25% finance, 4.8% chemistry, 4.35% engineering, and 6.6% other subjects. Construction and filtering: educational webpages retrieved from scientific seed images are converted into QA pairs, GPT-4o supplies multiple worked answers, and validity, image relevance, majority consistency, and alignment with available web solutions filter the release. License / access constraints: public dataset access is governed by the Hugging Face platform terms and the code repository is MIT licensed, but no dataset-specific content license was confirmed; platform access does not grant redistribution rights for the underlying webpages or images, so record-level review is required. Intended use: multimodal and text reasoning SFT.

VisualWebInstruct 把以图像引导的教育网页搜索转化为可复用的多模态“问题—完整解答”示范，并通过答案一致性与来源解答对齐筛选 SFT 目标。其最接近的比较对象是 LLaVA-CoT 与 MAmmoTH-VL 数据；以验证器或 RL 为中心的工作只属于相邻方向，因为核心产物是公开的静态示范，而不是奖励信号。

Google Scholar 引用数：34（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=VisualWebInstruct%3A+Scaling+up+Multimodal+Instruction+Data+through+Web+Search&author=Yiming+Jia&hl=en）

开源数据：有。 数据集名称：VisualWebInstruct。 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/VisualWebInstruct。 规模：906,160 条问答，包含 257,201 个不同问题，其中 347,313 条关联图像，共涉及 163,743 张不同图像。 记录形式：完整问题、可选的相关图像引用，以及保留数学记号和分步解释的完整解答；发布内容在可用时还包含来源与过滤沿袭信息。 文件/存储格式：一个由 Hugging Face 托管的 Parquet 分片和 images.zip；仓库还以 JSONL 与 Parquet 两种格式提供混合对话记录和问答记录。 领域/语言：以英文教育问答为主，其中数学占 62.5%、物理占 14.5%、金融占 7.25%、化学占 4.8%、工程占 4.35%，其他学科占 6.6%。 构造与过滤：先从科学种子图像检索教育网页并抽取问答，再由 GPT-4o 生成多个完整解答，最后通过有效性、图像相关性、多数一致性以及与可获得网页解答的对齐检查筛选发布记录。 许可/访问约束：公开数据访问受 Hugging Face 平台条款约束，代码仓库采用 MIT 许可，但尚未确认数据集专用内容许可；平台访问不授予底层网页或图像的再分发权，仍需逐条审核记录。 预期用途：多模态与文本推理 SFT。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Retrieve webpages. Start from roughly 30,000 Stemez scientific images, request about 60 Google Lens results per image, and reduce 1,747,634 collected URLs to 758,490 unique educational candidates after domain filtering and deduplication.
  2. Extract records. Convert HTML into accessibility trees that preserve relevant text-image hierarchy. Gemini 1.5 Flash extracts complete questions, relevant images, notation, and worked solutions, yielding 421,320 raw QA pairs; a second validity and image-relevance pass retains 361,015.
  3. Refine answers. GPT-4o generates four solutions for each question. A GPT-4o judge keeps records when more than half of the conclusions agree, producing 1,041,598 expanded QA pairs before final alignment.
  4. Align and package. Gemini 2.0 Flash compares synthetic responses with available web answers; inconsistent cases use the web answer. The final output is 906,160 QA pairs with 257,201 unique questions, 347,313 image-associated pairs, and 163,743 unique images.
  5. Consume and verify. SFT trains LLaVA-OneVision-mid or MAmmoTH-VL for one epoch; the best run mixes VisualWebInstruct with modified LLaVA-CoT at 9:1. Reproduction should pin commercial-model versions, search results, filtering prompts, source URLs, image files, and dataset revision; total generation cost, random seeds, and dataset-specific license are not disclosed.

1. 检索网页。 从约 30,000 张 Stemez 科学图像出发，每张图像请求约 60 个 Google Lens 结果，再经域名过滤和去重，把收集到的 1,747,634 个 URL 缩减为 758,490 个不同的教育候选页面。
  2. 抽取记录。 将 HTML 转换为保留相关文本与图像层级的可访问性树。Gemini 1.5 Flash 抽取完整问题、相关图像、数学记号与完整解答，得到 421,320 条原始问答；第二次有效性和图像相关性筛选保留 361,015 条。
  3. 精炼答案。 GPT-4o 为每个问题生成四份解答；GPT-4o judge 仅在超过半数结论一致时保留记录，最终对齐前得到 1,041,598 条扩展问答。
  4. 对齐并打包。 Gemini 2.0 Flash 比较合成回答与可获得的网页答案；不一致时采用网页答案。最终输出为 906,160 条问答，包含 257,201 个不同问题、347,313 条图像关联问答和 163,743 张不同图像。
  5. 消费与核验。 SFT 对 LLaVA-OneVision-mid 或 MAmmoTH-VL 训练一个 epoch；最佳实验按 9:1 混合 VisualWebInstruct 与修改后的 LLaVA-CoT。复现时需要固定商业模型版本、搜索结果、筛选 prompt、来源 URL、图像文件与数据集 revision；总生成成本、随机种子和数据集专用许可证未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. In the controlled data ablation, LLaVA-OneVision-mid rises from a 26.3 seven-benchmark average to 38.1 with VisualWebInstruct, compared with 33.6 using LLaVA-CoT; mixing both reaches 39.7. On the stronger MAmmoTH-VL backbone, VisualWebInstruct raises the average from 45.4 to 49.0, and the mixed run reaches 50.4.
  1. The final 7B MAmmoTH-VL2 reports 40.7 on MMMU-Pro standard, 68.1 on MathVista, 42.6 on MathVerse, and 55.7 on DynaMath. These results support the SFT utility claim for the reported backbones and data mixture, but they do not isolate web retrieval from teacher strength or prove correctness of every released trace.

1. 在受控数据消融中，LLaVA-OneVision-mid 的七项 benchmark 平均分从 26.3 提升到使用 VisualWebInstruct 时的 38.1，而使用 LLaVA-CoT 时为 33.6；两者混合达到 39.7。对更强的 MAmmoTH-VL backbone，VisualWebInstruct 把平均分从 45.4 提高到 49.0，混合训练达到 50.4。
  1. 最终的 7B MAmmoTH-VL2 在 MMMU-Pro standard、MathVista、MathVerse 和 DynaMath 上分别报告 40.7、68.1、42.6 和 55.7。这些结果支持该数据在已报告 backbone 与数据混合条件下的 SFT 效用，但不能把收益完全归因于网页检索，也不能证明每条公开推理轨迹都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier multimodal reasoning corpora were often small, domain-specific, or generated from fixed synthetic-image rules. VisualWebInstruct changes the construction surface by using images as web-search keys, then preserving webpage text-image structure before synthesizing and aligning worked answers. Its direction signal is the combination of large-scale natural visual retrieval and explicit SFT-ready reasoning targets, not a new model architecture or consistency algorithm. The official EMNLP 2025 Main record and controlled data ablations are quality signals, while source rights, teacher-correlated errors, and weakly specified decontamination remain the main reuse checks.

既有多模态推理语料往往规模较小、领域单一，或者由固定的合成图像规则生成。VisualWebInstruct 的变化在于用图像作为网页搜索键，并在合成和对齐完整答案之前保留网页中的文本与图像结构。它的方向信号是大规模自然视觉检索与可直接用于 SFT 的推理目标相结合，而不是新的模型架构或一致性算法。EMNLP 2025 Main 正式记录和受控数据消融提供了质量信号，但来源权利、teacher 相关错误和说明不足的去污染过程仍是复用前的主要检查项。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Majority agreement among four GPT-4o samples is not an external correctness proof; correlated errors can survive. Reusers should manually audit intermediate reasoning and compare against independent answer checkers where possible.
  • Google Lens retrieval, membership filtering, and source availability shape the domain, language, copyright, and difficulty distribution. Reusers should retain source provenance and conduct rights and representation reviews instead of treating the mixture as uniformly reusable.
  • The paper states that benchmark decontamination was performed but omits its algorithm and counts, while the strongest result also mixes LLaVA-CoT. Reusers should rerun overlap detection and report both VisualWebInstruct-only and mixed-data results.

• 四份 GPT-4o 样本的多数一致性并不是外部正确性证明，相关错误仍可能被保留。复用者应抽查中间推理，并在可能时与独立答案检查器比较。
  • Google Lens 检索、会员页面过滤与来源可用性共同决定领域、语言、版权和难度分布。复用者应保留来源 provenance，并进行权利与代表性审计，不能把混合数据视为统一可复用。
  • 论文称已执行 benchmark 去污染，但未给出算法和命中数量，最强结果还混入了 LLaVA-CoT。复用者应重跑重叠检测，并分别报告仅用 VisualWebInstruct 与混合数据的结果。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the released QA/image records as a broad multimodal SFT source when narrow chart, geometry, or elementary-science datasets do not cover the target distribution.
  • Reuse the two-stage pipeline as a checklist: image-based retrieval, accessibility-tree extraction, record validity filtering, multi-answer consistency, and source-answer alignment.
  • Use the reported LLaVA-OneVision and MAmmoTH-VL ablations as baselines, but preserve source URLs, dataset revision, teacher versions, and an independent rights/correctness audit.

• 当狭窄的图表、几何或基础科学数据集不能覆盖目标分布时，可把公开问答与图像记录作为更广泛的多模态 SFT 来源。
  • 可把两阶段流程复用为检查清单：基于图像的检索、可访问性树抽取、记录有效性筛选、多答案一致性和来源答案对齐。
  • 可将 LLaVA-OneVision 与 MAmmoTH-VL 的消融结果作为 baseline，但必须保留来源 URL、数据集 revision、teacher 版本，并执行独立的权利与正确性审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The direct answer is a 906,160-record web-derived reasoning SFT set, not a new inference scaffold.
  2. The decisive construction path is image search, accessibility-tree extraction, four-answer consistency filtering, and source alignment.
  3. The record is a question plus optional relevant images and a worked response; the final set has 347,313 image-associated pairs.
  4. The clearest evidence is the backbone-controlled average gain from 26.3 to 38.1 on LLaVA-OneVision-mid and from 45.4 to 49.0 on MAmmoTH-VL.
  5. Before reuse, verify source rights, dataset-specific terms, teacher-correlated correctness, decontamination, and gains without the LLaVA-CoT mixture.

1. 论文的直接答案是一个含 906,160 条记录的网页来源推理 SFT 数据集，而不是新的推理脚手架。
  2. 决定数据质量的路径是图像搜索、可访问性树抽取、四答案一致性筛选和来源答案对齐。
  3. 一条记录由问题、可选的相关图像与完整回答组成；最终数据中有 347,313 条图像关联问答。
  4. 最清晰的证据是在控制 backbone 后，LLaVA-OneVision-mid 的平均分从 26.3 升到 38.1，MAmmoTH-VL 从 45.4 升到 49.0。
  5. 复用前必须核对来源权利、数据集专用条款、teacher 相关正确性、去污染过程，以及不混入 LLaVA-CoT 时的收益。
